description.en: Weijian Shi at Fudan University. Research interests in embodied intelligence, robot learning, and mixture-of-experts models.
description.zh: Weijian Shi，复旦大学。关注具身智能、机器人学习与混合专家模型。

intro.en: I’m interested in how intelligent systems learn to act in the physical world.
intro.zh: 我关注智能系统如何学习，并在真实的物理世界中行动。

bio.en: My research interests lie at the intersection of embodied intelligence, robot learning, and mixture-of-experts models. I explore what a model’s internal dynamics can tell us about its behavior — and how that understanding can inform more reliable, efficient learning.
bio.zh: 我的研究兴趣包括具身智能、机器人学习和混合专家模型。我希望理解模型内部动态与外部行为之间的联系，并探索如何利用这种理解，提高学习效率与执行可靠性。

description.en: How do learned policies turn perception into purposeful action in the physical world?
description.zh: 学习得到的策略，如何将感知转化为物理世界中有目的的行动？

tags.zh: 机器人学习 · 策略行为

description.en: What can routing dynamics and expert interactions reveal about a model’s behavior?
description.zh: 路由动态与专家之间的交互，能够揭示哪些模型行为的规律？

tags.zh: 稀疏模型 · 内部动态

description.en: How can we learn with less data, recover from failures, and improve the quality of execution?
description.zh: 如何用更少的数据学习、从失败中恢复，并提升任务执行质量？

tags.zh: 数据效率 · 失败恢复

title.zh: 理解模型内部，探索更可靠的机器人行为。

description.en: Exploring intrinsic signals in mixture-of-experts policies for execution monitoring, recovery, and learning. The work connects patterns inside a model with the behavior of a robot over time.
description.zh: 探索混合专家策略中的内在信号，用于执行监测、失败恢复与学习。研究关注模型内部模式与机器人执行过程之间的联系。

questions.en: Execution monitoring from the first policy inference.
questions.zh: 从第一次策略推理开始进行执行监测。

questions.en: Recovery evaluated through task outcomes, including both benefits and harms.
questions.zh: 通过任务结果评估恢复操作，同时考察收益与损害。

questions.en: Using model structure to guide more efficient training and data use.
questions.zh: 利用模型结构探索更高效的训练与数据利用方式。

questions.en: Improving the smoothness and directness of successful executions.
questions.zh: 提升成功执行过程的流畅性，减少不必要的动作。

contact.en: Interested in robot learning, embodied intelligence, or the inner workings of models? Let’s connect.
contact.zh: 如果你也关注机器人学习、具身智能，或模型内部的工作机制，欢迎交流。
